projectSummary: Two things follow for this slice. The pectoralis major is activated during the barbell bench press, and the amount depends on the range of motion used. Because the electrodes were placed at four sites spanning both portions, this is also portion-resolved evidence that regional excitation differs within the muscle during a press.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Acute EMG amplitude is a tier-4 proxy; master plan section 2.2 forbids presenting it as a measurement of hypertrophy.
Crosstalk handling is not described in the retrieved text, and the surface-EMG limitation recorded from the pectoralis-specific methods literature applies.

study.intervention: full-range bench press; upper-half and lower-half bench press
study.population: Nineteen healthy male volunteers with at least one year of resistance-training experience performed a 10RM bench press across three ranges of motion: full, upper half, and lower half. Sample size was estimated a priori at 17 for f = 0.326, alpha 0.05, power 0.8.

title: Acute muscle excitation response across various bench press ranges of motion.
